user.title: Pair CinemaSeat
user.description: Keep this form open. On the Apple TV, open CinemaSeat → Settings → Home Assistant, enter this Home Assistant address and port, and request a pairing code. Enter the six digits shown on the TV. The player ID and connection key are transferred automatically.

data.pairing_code: Six-digit code shown on Apple TV
data.name: Player name (optional)

reconfigure.title: Pair CinemaSeat again
reconfigure.description: On this Apple TV, request a new code in CinemaSeat → Settings → Home Assistant. Enter the six digits here. This replaces the stored connection key while retaining the player and its entity.

data.pairing_code: Six-digit code shown on Apple TV
data.name: Player name (optional)

error.invalid_code: Code is invalid, expired, or the Apple TV disconnected. Request a new six-digit code.
error.wrong_player: This code belongs to another Apple TV. Request a code on the original player.

abort.already_configured: This player is already configured. Open its CinemaSeat entry and choose Reconfigure to pair it again.
abort.cannot_connect: The CinemaSeat pairing endpoint could not start. Check Home Assistant logs.
